title: E7 output (script: scripts/rate_difficulty.py) -- one report per run
description: E7 is SCRIPT-ONLY, so this schema describes the script's REPORT, not an agent answer -- the same arrangement as F3, whose report is its output. The report exists so that the banding can be checked without re-reading 580 rows. WHAT A BAND IS: solution load counted from the printed page -- ECAT's cognitive_demand and solution_structure, how many items the E1 shape forces the student to adjudicate, whether a figure or table gates the question, whether the task is negated, and whether a trap removes any part-way shortcut. WHAT IT IS NOT: a prediction of how students perform. We hold no response data, and SPEC Rule 22 forbids asserting student behaviour -- it is the rule that retired `obviously_wrong`. `not_scorable` is a first-class outcome, not a failure: a question that is source_incomplete, or whose ECAT fields are unfilled, must have NO band, because a band computed from empty inputs is indistinguishable from a real one (SPEC Rule 19).

bands.description: How many questions landed in each band. config/allowed_values.yaml `difficulty_band`.

not_scorable.description: No band assigned, deliberately: source_incomplete, or ECAT has not filled cognitive_demand and solution_structure. scripts/checks/E7.py requires questions == easy + medium + hard + not_scorable, so a row can never be silently dropped.

reasons.description: Why rows were not scorable, counted by reason. Optional.
